login.title: Sign in to TransitForge
login.token_lead: Paste an operator or readonly API token. It is stored only in an HTTP-only session cookie.
login.hint: This UI binds to localhost by default. Do not expose it without the same network controls as the API.

error.agent_token: use an operator or readonly token

setup.title: Create administrator
setup.hint: Username is a lowercase DNS label. Password must be at least 10 characters. You can enable TOTP after sign-in.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.lead: Enter a TOTP code from your authenticator app, or a one-time recovery code.

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.lead: RU-side edge nodes. Status refreshes about every 8 seconds.
dash.refresh_failed: Could not refresh node status. Showing last successful data.

reason.agent_not_reported: Agent has not reported actual state yet.
reason.transport_degraded: Transport is not on the WireGuard primary path.
reason.handshake_stale: WireGuard handshake is older than one hour.
reason.agent_healthy: Agent is reporting and transport is on the primary path.
reason.interface_missing: Tunnel interface is not present on the node.
reason.handshake_warning: WireGuard handshake is older than three minutes.
reason.tunnel_healthy: Tunnel interface is present and handshake is recent.
reason.tunnel_unknown: Agent has not reported this tunnel yet.

field.name: Name
field.private_key_path: Private key file path on the node

nodes.title: Entry Nodes
nodes.lead: Edge boxes on the RU side. DNS for customer domains should point at a node’s public IP.
nodes.detail_lead: Node diagnostic view: inventory, last reported actual state, and the current reconcile plan.
nodes.plan_help: Read-only difference between desired state and last stored actual state. This does not write an audit event.
nodes.failback_help: Failback switches this node from SSH fallback (SSH_PRIMARY) back to WireGuard (WG_PRIMARY).
nodes.live_apply_disabled: Live apply is not enabled on this controller.
nodes.empty_tunnels: No tunnels configured for this node.
nodes.empty_mappings: No mappings configured for this node.
nodes.empty_sni: No SNI routes configured for this node.
nodes.confirm_failback: Switch this node from SSH fallback back to WireGuard?

backends.title: Backends
backends.lead: Foreign boxes (typically xray) reached over overlay from a node. Address is the overlay IPv4, not a public IP.
backends.empty_tunnels: No tunnels point at this backend yet.

tunnels.title: Tunnels
tunnels.lead: Overlay links from a node to a backend. Private keys are path references on the node — never pasted here.
tunnels.key_help: Filesystem path only. Do not paste key material.

mappings.title: Port mappings
mappings.lead: Public port on a node forwarded to a service on a backend overlay address.
mappings.enable_title: Disabled: mapping remains in inventory and is removed from desired state. Click to include it in desired state.
mappings.disable_title: Enabled: mapping participates in desired state. Click to disable: it stays in inventory but is omitted from desired state.

sni.title: SNI routes
sni.lead: TLS hostname on a node listen address (usually :443) mapped to a backend. One default backend per listen.

events.title: Events
events.lead: Controller audit log. Filters are sent to the API as query parameters and are bookmarkable.

users.title: Users & Access
users.lead: Human accounts for this Web UI. API tokens remain a separate machine identity and are minted with transitforge.
users.tokens_lead: Token secrets are never shown again after mint. Use transitforge token add for new machine tokens.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Language, password, and two-factor authentication for the signed-in account.
settings.password_current: Does not apply — administrators reset other accounts from Users & Access.
settings.totp_help: Scan or enter the secret in an authenticator app, then confirm with a 6-digit code. Recovery codes are shown once.
settings.recovery_warn: Store these codes offline. Each code can be used once. They will not be shown again.
settings.token_session: This session was opened with an API token. Password and TOTP settings require a human account.

apiref.title: API Reference
apiref.lead: REST surface of this controller. Method names and paths are not translated. Authentication for external clients is Bearer plus HMAC; the Web UI uses a loopback session.

p.users_patch: update a human user (self: locale/password; administrator: role/disabled)
p.totp_confirm: confirm TOTP and return recovery codes once
p.plan: read-only Diff plan; no apply audit
p.apply: explicit apply; dry_run: true is audited
